title: BravesVision Top 10 2026
description:
Phillies at Braves, April 26
Chris Sale wins the 150th game of his career, allowing one hit over six innings with nine strikeouts; Matt Olson's three-run homer off Aaron Nola opens the scoring as Atlanta beats Philadelphia 6-2 and becomes the first club to 20 wins.

title: Behind the Braves
description: Catcher and 2025 NL Rookie of the Year Drake Baldwin joins broadcaster Ben Ingram to discuss his career, his hard work behind the plate and his experiences playing in Major League Baseball.

title: Michael Harris II: The Dream and the Journey
description: Chronicles Michael Harris II's journey as a kid from Atlanta to his big-league debut for his hometown team; featuring conversations with Michael, his parents, high school coaches, mentors and scouts.

description:

description:
Nationals at Braves, 5/22/26
Bryce Elder's eighth quality start drops his ERA to 1.97, then CJ Abrams twice puts Washington ahead. Chadwick Tromp answers with a two-out single in the 11th, the first walk-off hit of his career, for a 5-4 Braves win.

description:
August 11
August 11: Joey Votto homers twice, the second off Will Smith to force extra innings. Ozzie Albies answers in the 11th with a 412-foot walk-off three-run shot, an 8-6 win that pulls the Braves into a tie for first in the NL East.

title: Celebrating '21
description:
August 15
August 15: Dansby Swanson homers for a third straight game, Freddie Freeman and Austin Riley go back-to-back, and the Braves complete a sweep at Nationals Park 6-5 to take sole possession of first place for the first time all season.

title: BravesVision Top 10 2026
description:
Tigers at Braves, April 29
Ozzie Albies homers off Tarik Skubal in the first, and Skubal shuts Atlanta down from there. Then Matt Olson ends it, driving a two-run walk-off homer into the Braves bullpen off Kenley Jansen for a 4-3 win over Detroit.

title: Always Believe: The Ozzie Albies Story
description: Always Believe: The Ozzie Albies Story, presented by Harrah's Cherokee Casinos, takes fans on a visual journey detailing his upbringing and pride in his native country, Curaçao, his love for animals and the conception of the Ozzie Albies Foundation.

title: Behind the Braves
description: Get a behind-the-scenes look at how the catchers are developing this spring. Hear from catching coach Dustin Garneau and first-base coach Antoan Richardson on what it's been like to join the Braves staff.

description:
Royals at Braves, March 27
Opening Night at Truist Park; Chris Sale scatters three hits over six scoreless innings before a sellout crowd, and Ozzie Albies, Drake Baldwin and Michael Harris II all go deep in a 6-0 win over Kansas City; Walt Weiss earns his first win.

title: Becoming a Brave
description: Behind-the-scenes of the 2026 Atlanta Braves draft class, from scouting to the draft, and their introduction into the franchise.

title: Riding With the Braves
description:
Walt Weiss
New manager Walt Weiss joins Braves Radio Network's Ben Ingram to talk about his career playing, coaching and what his mindset is heading into the 2026 season.

title: Celebrating '21
description:
July 4
July 4: Down 7-3 entering the ninth, the Braves rally to force extras, then win it in the most unlikely way: with the bench empty, pitcher Max Fried steps in and lines a walk-off single to beat Miami 8-7 in 10 innings.
